name: matched-ks3-all-width1280-normlr
hypothesis: Increase both dense and routed rank-one KS3 widths from1024 to1280 after the width768 normalized-rate candidate was proxy-pruned. Unlike the earlier dense-only1280 trial, this expands routed capacity too. Set projection multiplier sqrt(1024/1280) so original ANVIL shape scaling leaves the effective rate unchanged. Keep geometry Adam0.125, zero coefficients, BF16 GS32, topology and frozen shared/model-wide settings. Gate on CPU architecture/optimizer checks, a width1280 numerical oracle and actual full-graph warmup.
